summary: Iteration 15 - Complete testing of bug fixes and new features. 10/11 backend tests passed (1 minor failure on deprecated test credential). All critical bugs verified as fixed. Frontend UI testing completed successfully via Playwright.

minor.issue: Test credential anna.weber@test.com may have been changed/deleted - not a bug, test data issue

device_edit_objectid_bug_fix.result: Successfully updated model to 'Aggreko' without 500 error. image_gridfs_id properly serialized as string.

monitoring_page_loads.result: Page shows 12 total generators (5 real + 7 device-synced from Stromerzeuger/Lichtmast). No loading errors.

parts_types_list.result: Returns all 8 required types: Kraftstoffvorfilter, Kraftstofffilter, Ölfilter, Keilriemen, Umlenkrollen, Wasserpumpe, Luftfilter, Motoröl

parts_dropdown_frontend.result: Shows all 8 types plus 'Sonderteil (Freitext)...' option for custom parts

motoroel_liters_field.test: When Motoröl selected, liters field appears

sonderteil_free_text.test: Custom part type creation via 'Sonderteil (Freitext)' option
sonderteil_free_text.result: API accepts any custom part_type value. Frontend allows free text entry.

techniker_readonly.test: Techniker field in maintenance entry form is read-only
techniker_readonly.result: HTML shows readonly='' attribute. Field displays logged-in user name and cannot be edited.

serviceplan_row_click.test: Device list rows are clickable buttons (no separate Details button)
serviceplan_row_click.result: Device rows are <button> elements. Clicking opens plan detail or create plan modal.

mandatory_months_hours_fields.test: Both 'In Monaten' and 'In Betriebsstunden' fields visible and marked as mandatory
mandatory_months_hours_fields.result: Both fields show '*' marker and are present in the maintenance entry form.

seed_data_creation: Created test parts (Motoröl with liters, custom Sonderteil) during API testing - cleaned up after tests
